name: Targeted Therapy for EGFR+ NSCLC
description: A study evaluating the efficacy of a new tyrosine kinase inhibitor in patients with EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer.

name: Immunotherapy in PD-L1 High Expression
description: Investigating a novel PD-1 inhibitor in treatment-naive patients with advanced NSCLC and high PD-L1 expression (TPS >= 50%).

name: ALK Rearrangement Refractory Study
description: A study for patients with ALK-positive NSCLC who have progressed on previous ALK inhibitors.

name: PARP Inhibitor in BRCA-Mutated Cancers
description: Evaluating the efficacy of a novel PARP inhibitor in patients with advanced solid tumors harboring BRCA1 or BRCA2 pathogenic mutations.

name: Precision Therapy for BRCA2+ Prostate Cancer
description: A targeted approach using combination therapy for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer with BRCA2 mutations.

name: BRAF V600E Targeted Inhibitor Trial
description: Clinical evaluation of a next-generation BRAF inhibitor for advanced melanoma patients with BRAF V600E mutations.

name: KRAS G12D Inhibitor in GI Cancers
description: Phase 1/2 study of a specific KRAS G12D inhibitor in patients with advanced colorectal and pancreatic cancers.
